title: upgrade: attention kernels -> flashattnv2 + fused ops + rotary/rope optimizations (scheduling & continuous batching fixes)
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: bring FlashAttnV2 into the serving runtime to reduce per-token latency and enable fused rotary/rope ops with improved KV-cache locality. This change upgrades the attention kernel and introduces a small fused-op library for rotary/rope application, plus scheduler hooks to avoid KV-cache stalls and a continuous-batching fallback when throughput patterns are spiky. Changes were carefully gated behind a feature flag and validated against our internal evals. What this PR does: 1) bump flashattn -> FlashAttnV2-compatible kernels and ABI shims; 2) add fused rotary/rope fused_op kernels which apply positional transforms during the attention GEMM to reduce memory copies; 3) KV cache alignment and prefetch hints to reduce cache-miss stalls for long-context scenarios; 4) scheduler improvements to avoid head-of-line blocking when mixing short and long sequences; 5) continuous batching path improvements so short requests can be coalesced without increasing tail latency; 6) regression tests + microbench harness + perf dashboards. Checklist: - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] microbench harness added (bench/attn) - [x] end-to-end latency & throughput benchmarks - [x] rollout feature-flag gating + metrics - [x] docs note in runtime/CHANGELOG.md Key results from internal perf runs (A100, fp16, eval-suite): - single-request median latency down ~18% for 32k rotary models - throughput up ~24% in mixed short/long workloads when continuous batching enabled - KV-cache miss rate down ~40% in syntheticshift tests Compatibility notes: We keep the legacy kernels behind a runtime flag; new fused ops fallback to legacy code for unsupported dtypes/hw. See release_notes.

release_notes: Upgraded attention kernels to FlashAttnV2 with new fused rotary/rope kernels. Reduces latency and improves throughput for mixed short/long workloads. Feature gated; enable via runtime flag ATTN_FLASHATTN_V2=true. See runtime/CHANGELOG.md for details and rollback instructions.
